title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Charges for Corrections After Issue
content:
This page is the tariff for corrections made to `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` once they have been issued. It says which post-issue corrections are free, which are charged, at what rate, and against what kind of document a correction fee may be entered.

## Charging clauses

1. **Consignee change.** Replacing the named consignee after issue is charged the tier's consignee change fee. That fee takes the place of the ordinary correction fee; the two are never charged for the same request.
2. **Other corrections.** Every other post-issue correction is free as long as the corrections already completed after issue on that document are fewer than the tier's free allowance. The count takes in each completed correction request registered on or after the date of issue, whatever particular it changed, and leaves out the request being charged.
3. When the free allowance is used up, the correction costs the tier's before-departure fee if the carrying vessel has not yet sailed, or the tier's after-departure fee, which also covers amending the manifest, if it has.
4. **Line's own keying error.** A correction needed only because the line keyed the document wrongly against the shipping instructions is never charged, whatever the allowance or the stage.
5. **Status of the document.** A correction fee is entered only against a document whose status is issued.
6. **Once per request.** No correction request is ever charged more than once.

## Tariff by document type (USD)

| Document type | Free corrections after issue | Fee before departure (per correction) | Fee after departure (per correction) | Consignee change fee (per change) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | 1 | 50.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | 1 | 40.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | 0 | 75.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | 0 | 95.00 | 175.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | 0 | 110.00 | 200.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | 0 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 |

## Charge decision (condition, judgement, result)

| Kind of correction | Completed post-issue corrections compared with allowance | Vessel sailed? | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Caused by the line's keying error | any | any | None |
| Change of named consignee | not relevant | any | Consignee change fee |
| Any other particular | fewer than the allowance | any | None |
| Any other particular | allowance reached | No | Before-departure fee |
| Any other particular | allowance reached | Yes | After-departure fee |

## Worked example (hypothetical sequence)

An `AHL Sea Waybill` is issued. Its first post-issue correction, to the notify party, is free: no correction had yet been completed after issue and the allowance is 1. Its second, replacing the consignee before sailing, is charged the consignee change fee of 100.00 rather than a correction fee. Its third, to the cargo description while the vessel is still alongside, finds two completed post-issue corrections on record, so it is charged the before-departure fee of 50.00; had the vessel already sailed, the charge would have been 100.00.
